name: Satou Kazuma
source:
A game-obsessed shut-in, having had his heart broken over his childhood friend during middle school. After dying from acute stress reaction, he is sent to the parallel reality where he becomes a role-playing game character. As an Adventurer class, he learns basic skills such as stealing, archery, monster detection, and magic.

[From Wikipedia]
